Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Livingston Group Asset Management Southport Capital Management Has Boosted Holding in Qualcomm Com (QCOM); At&T (T) Holder Bingham Osborn & Scarborough Cut Its Position by $429,975 
March 10, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia 
Bingham Osborn & Scarborough Llc decreased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 33.03%   Bingham Osborn & Scarborough Llc sold 11,025 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.81% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 22,358 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $876,000, down from 33,383 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bingham Osborn & Scarborough Llc who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $227.45 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.16% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $37.05. About 18.82M shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 0.52% since March 10, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.22% the S&P500. 
Livingston Group Asset Management Southport Capital Management increased its stake in Qualcomm Inc Com (QCOM) by 21.34%   Livingston Group Asset Management Southport Capital Management bought 7,415 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.14%   42,154 shares of the radio and television broadcasting and communications equipment company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.19 million, up from 34,739 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Livingston Group Asset Management Southport Capital Management who had been investing in Qualcomm Inc Com for   $93.31 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.96% or $1.21 during the last trading session, reaching $63.03. About 7.66M shares traded. QUALCOMM Incorporated (NASDAQ:QCOM) has risen 9.31%   underperformed by 7.39% the S&P500. 
Since September 27, 2017, it had 0 insider purchases, and 5 selling transactions for $2.98 million activity. $2.81 million worth of stock was sold by GROB MATTHEW S on Tuesday, January 9. 
Among 36 analysts covering Qualcomm Inc. ( NASDAQ:QCOM ), 16 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 19 Hold. Therefore 44% are positive. Qualcomm Inc. had 134 analyst reports since July 23, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. On Thursday, July 21 the stock rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Outperform”. Mizuho maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Wednesday, January 17 report. Canaccord Genuity maintained it with “Buy” rating and $86.0 target in Tuesday, January 16 report. Goldman Sachs maintained the shares of QCOM in report on Thursday, July 21 with “Buy” rating. The rating was initiated by JP Morgan with “Neutral” on Tuesday, September 8. As per Wednesday, April 19, the company rating was downgraded by Rosenblatt. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Monday, November 6 by UBS. Argus Research maintained QUALCOMM Incorporated (NASDAQ:QCOM) on Thursday, September 29 with “Buy” rating. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, November 2 by Northland Capital. The rating was maintained by Topeka Capital Markets on Thursday, November 5 with “Hold”. 
Investors sentiment decreased to 0.85 in 2017 Q3. Its down 0.13, from 0.98 in 2017Q2. It dived, as 83 investors sold QCOM shares while 490 reduced holdings. 89 funds opened positions while 397 raised stakes. 1.10 billion shares or 0.88% less from 1.11 billion shares in 2017Q2 were reported. Kistler holds 0.12% in QUALCOMM Incorporated (NASDAQ:QCOM) or 5,626 shares. Choate reported 5,943 shares. Cleararc Cap stated it has 48,784 shares or 0.38% of all its holdings. Primecap Mngmt Ca holds 15.41M shares. First Foundation accumulated 0.88% or 298,361 shares. Boys Arnold Company holds 0.22% or 26,146 shares. Parus Fin (Uk) Ltd holds 141,632 shares or 1.29% of its portfolio. 101,617 were accumulated by Sg Americas Secs Limited Liability Co. Stratos Wealth Prns Limited holds 168,675 shares or 0.41% of its portfolio. Parsons Capital Management Incorporated Ri accumulated 26,622 shares. Utah Retirement System, a Utah-based fund reported 271,358 shares. Ancora Advisors Ltd holds 0.15% or 50,022 shares in its portfolio. 
Livingston Group Asset Management Southport Capital Management, which manages about $220.76 million and $235.00M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3,104 shares to 49,545 shares, valued at $7.64 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. 
Analysts await AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) to report earnings on April, 24. They expect $0.85 earnings per share, up 14.86% or $0.11 from last year’s $0.74 per share. T’s profit will be $5.22 billion for 10.90 P/E if the $0.85 EPS becomes a reality.
